details.description: Llama 3 70B Instruct is Meta's 70-billion-parameter instruction-tuned model from the original Llama 3 family, released April 18, 2024, and optimized for assistant-like chat. Meta states the model is intended for English only and was tested only in English. It was Meta's flagship open-weight chat model at launch, since followed by the longer-context Llama 3.1, 3.2 and 3.3 releases. AWS Bedrock's model card lists this model's lifecycle as Active.
advantages: Scores 82.0 on MMLU (5-shot), per Meta's model card.
Scores 81.7 pass@1 on HumanEval (0-shot), per Meta's model card.
Scores 93.0 on GSM-8K (8-shot, CoT), per Meta's model card.
Scores 50.4 on MATH (4-shot, CoT) and 39.5 on GPQA (0-shot), per Meta's model card.
Meta describes reduced false-refusal rates and improved alignment compared to Llama 2, per Meta's announcement.
disadvantages: Meta states the model is intended for English only and was tested only in English; use in other languages is listed as out-of-scope.
Knowledge cutoff of December 2023, per Meta's model card.
Meta's model card does not describe tool-calling or function-calling support, unlike the later Llama 3.1, 3.2 and 3.3 releases.
Superseded by Meta's later Llama 3.1, 3.2 and 3.3 releases, which extended the context window to 128K tokens, per those releases' Meta and AWS Bedrock model cards.
use_cases: Text extraction, classification, rewriting and summarization

sources.title: Introducing Meta Llama 3: The most capable openly available LLM to date

notes: Facts list max_input_tokens as 8000/8192 and max_output_tokens as 2048/8192 across bedrock regional variants; Meta's and AWS Bedrock's model cards state a uniform 8,192-token (8K) context window and 8K max output, consistent with the catalog's larger values. AWS Bedrock's model card (fetched 2026-09-24) lists this model's lifecycle as Active.
